versions.changelog: Refuses live trades without a preflight ok_to_trade; exits 2 with an install hint when simmer-sdk is below the floor; EXPOSURE_CAP copy aligned.

- Version bump to 0.3.2.
- Marked skill as read-only in metadata.
- Updated internal version fields in SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
Rename from preflight → simmer-preflight (follows simmer-<tool> naming convention). Fix displayName to Simmer Preflight.

- New version 0.3.0 adds detailed documentation outlining how to use the simmer-preflight readiness check before trades.
- Describes the single-call API, returning wallet identity, venue status, spendable balance, open exposure, and an ok_to_trade verdict.
- Clarifies when and how often to use preflight, including examples and use cases for safe automated trading.
- Documents all fields returned in the result, possible blocker codes, and distinctions between warnings and blockers.
- Explains preflight’s read-only nature, API usage cadence, and current limitations (e.g., gas balance is not returned).
- Provides links to API reference and wallet guide for further details.
